# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. This release consolidates the full 4.147.x preview series into a stable build. It adds variable font shaping, animated WebP encoding, color font palette support, and zero-copy stream conversion. The SKObject singleton lifecycle is reworked, legacy SKPaint text APIs are promoted to errors, and default typeface resolution is corrected for Android. Check the breaking-changes section before upgrading from 3.x.

## Breaking Changes

- **new SKFont() now uses an empty typeface instead of the lazy platform default** — Upstream m132 removed the lazy 'resolve default at draw time' pattern. SKFont() now stores SKTypeface.Empty, so MeasureText and Draw return zero/nothing. Construct with an explicit typeface: new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default). Detect 'unset' with font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of null.
- **new SKPaint().Typeface returns SKTypeface.Default, not null** — The underlying SkFont now seeds a default typeface so text still works, but null semantics changed. Code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect 'no typeface set' no longer fires — use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty instead.
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") returns Default, not null, on Android** — Android previously returned null for unknown font families; all platforms now return SKTypeface.Default. For strict null semantics use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name), which still returns null on no match.
- **SKStream.Move(long) throws OverflowException for out-of-range offsets and is now obsolete** — The long overload silently truncated large offsets. It now uses a checked cast and is marked [Obsolete]. Call Move(int) with an in-range value. Compiler warning CS0618 will guide migration.
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 — 1.1 is now required** — Ganesh now unconditionally acquires Vulkan 1.1 entry points; a 1.0 instance causes SK_ABORT (process termination, not an exception). Set VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion to VK_API_VERSION_1_1 AND set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to the same value — the default 0 is no longer safe.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative: five fields removed** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice are removed. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions, fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures, and delete the rest.
- **SKPaint text/font members promoted from warnings to compile errors** — The paint text/font members obsoleted in v3 (TextSize, Typeface, etc.) are now compile errors. Move typeface and text size onto SKFont. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))
- **Pre-v4 obsolete enums removed from the ref assembly** — Enums and members that were marked [Obsolete(error: true)] in the previews are removed from the reference assembly. Update any remaining callers to the v4 replacements. ([#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retype and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo loses value-equality** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo is now typed as GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (was GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo). GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo no longer implements IEquatable or exposes == / !=. Update construction and equality checks accordingly.
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed** — The setter for IgnorePublicDispose is no longer public. This property is lifecycle infrastructure; callers should not be setting it externally.

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia milestone m148** — The bundled Skia engine advances through milestones 132, 133, 147, and 148, incorporating years of upstream stability work, new rendering features, and bug fixes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044))

## API Surface

- **Variable font support added** — SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp gain variable-font axis enumeration and instance selection, allowing applications to access the full design space of variable fonts. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding via SKWebpEncoder** — SKWebpEncoder gains animated WebP support, letting consumers encode multi-frame WebP animations directly from SkiaSharp. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy data access** — A new GetData() method returns the stream contents as an SKData without an intermediate buffer copy, making stream-to-data conversion significantly cheaper. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKSamplingOptions added to SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface** — Both draw-surface APIs now accept an SKSamplingOptions parameter for explicit control over image filtering quality. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Missing API wrappers added and naming violations fixed** — A sweep of the binding layer added missing HarfBuzz and Skia API wrappers and corrected naming convention violations flagged by the new TreatWarningsAsErrors build. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPixmap.GetPixelSpan stride and offset corrected** — GetPixelSpan was computing stride using Width instead of RowBytes, and the (x,y) overload used Height instead of Width for the column offset — both now use the correct values. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first fixed** — If an SKPathBuilder was garbage-collected before its derived SKPath, the finalizer sequence caused a native crash. The object graph and disposal order are now correct. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Default typeface resolution moved to managed layer** — Android API 36+ could return null from the native default-typeface lookup; resolution now routes through SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily with a safe Empty fallback. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **WinUI .NET 9 projection DLL resolved** — The WinUI projection DLL search path was incorrect for .NET 9 consumers; the package now ships the correct reference. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **Android SKGLView stops rendering after MAUI TabBar tab switch fixed** — SKGLView no longer stops rendering after switching away and back to a tab in a MAUI TabBar on Android. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton instance lifecycle reworked** — The creation, caching, and disposal of singleton SKObject instances (typefaces, effects, shaders) is reworked to eliminate races and ensure correct lifetime management. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native-compat gate moved from ModuleInitializer to SkiaApi static constructor** — The native library compatibility check now fires in the SkiaApi static constructor rather than a module initializer, making it more reliable at load time across all host runtimes. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Apple 26.0 TFMs updated** — Library targets use versioned Apple 26.0 TFMs and app targets use the unversioned form, aligning with Apple SDK conventions for Xcode 26. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **Linux Bionic native assets added** — Native library assets for Linux Bionic are now included, enabling SkiaSharp use in Android-like Linux environments. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen x64 and arm64 native builds added** — Tizen support expands to x64 and arm64 architectures with updated Studio 6.1 tooling. ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **WASM pre-.NET 8 Emscripten builds dropped** — Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions targeting pre-.NET 8 runtimes are removed, reducing the build matrix and artifact size. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Security

- **Native dependencies updated** — expat updated to 2.8.1, freetype to 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, libpng to 1.6.58, libexpat to 2.7.5, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, and HarfBuzz to 14.2.0. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 with variable font axis support, color palette APIs (HBColor), Linux Bionic and Tizen x64/arm64 platform additions, and a Warnings-as-Errors binding cleanup pass.
